title: Author a small runtime-async workflow (experimental)
goal: Author a deliberately small experimental F# builder when a workflow needs runtime-managed waits and explicit failure and asynchronous cleanup rules.

selectionNotes: Experimental inline support; RC2 preview required. Pending generic Task upcast to Task is not supported by this bounded route.

prerequisites: Use the complete offline source/configuration and verify the consumer matches this route.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Use the .NET 11 SDK and its F# compiler for the declared target.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This verified edition targets net11.0; the .NET 10 sample is a comparison, not an older-target catalogue route.

language.reason: Use the declared compiler language mode; no later-main language gate is inferred.
language.name: fsharp

stabilityLimitations: Actual RC2 evidence; final GA reconciliation is separate.
constraints: No byref, byref-like or pinned value across suspension; no arbitrary callbacks, production-complete builder, AOT or complete debugger support.

packages.reason: The runtime intrinsics exist in the newer net10.0 Core asset; application runtime support is separately required.
packages.name: FSharp.Core
